# LAB_NETWORK

The docker network a lab's containers share, and the gateway address on it.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `network`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.network`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

| name | string |
